description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'DatabaseIT' for testing database functionalities within the OpenMRS framework. It includes setup and teardown methods for database initialization, database cleanup, and utility functions for managing Liquibase database migrations and connections, specifically targeting in-memory and containerized databases.

classes.name: DatabaseIT
classes.description: A JUnit test class for database integration testing, providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for managing in-memory and container databases within the OpenMRS environment.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the database before each test execution.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up database objects after each test.

methods.name: getLiquibase
methods.description: Creates a Liquibase object configured for the given changelog filename.

methods.name: initializeDatabase
methods.description: Sets up the database environment, choosing between in-memory or containerized based on system properties.

methods.name: setupContainerDB
methods.description: Starts a containerized database and updates connection URL accordingly.

methods.name: updateDatabase
methods.description: Applies Liquibase updates using the specified changelog filename.

methods.name: dropAllDatabaseObjects
methods.description: Drops all database objects, handling specific logic for different database types.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Provides a database connection with auto-commit disabled.

methods.name: useInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Determines whether to use an in-memory database based on system properties.
